thread:
lena (Finance): Heads up — HelmCare's Nov invoice INV-11022 shows a 3.2k burst/overage charge tied to their Dedicated commit true-up. Customer says they were in a failover window and expecting SLA credit. Can acct ops pull usage lines?
ajay (AcctOps): On it. grabbing metering CSV now. link: https://s3.redwood-internal/usage/helmcare/2026-11.csv
billing-bot: Automated meter calc: reserved_commit=120k tokens, billed_usage=143k tokens, burst=23k tokens, burst_charge=$3,200. SLA downtime flag detected for region-eu-west-1 between 2026-11-05 02:10-02:36 UTC.
sasha (Customer Success): HelmCare's PM is upset — says they couldn't failover to backup because the region outage impacted both primary + standby. Asking for full credit on the burst line.
dmitri (Sales): We promised a credit conversation during onboarding if platform issues caused overage. Recommend we offer SLA credit + waive a portion of the burst. What numbers do we need from finance to pre-approve?
lena (Finance): Need two things: 1) confirmed outage window (billing-bot shows it), 2) breakdown of which tokens were killed vs retried (to see if automatic retry inflated token counts). Ajay, can you run `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM token_events WHERE customer='helmcare' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-11-05T02:00Z' AND '2026-11-05T03:00Z';` and paste results?
ajay (AcctOps): Query result: total_tokens=23,420 during the window. Retried_tokens flagged=4,800. I'll attach the trimmed CSV lines for 02:10-02:36.
lena (Finance): Ok. Rough calc: billed burst 23k tokens -> $0.14/token = $3,220. Retried 4.8k tokens ~ $672 of that. If outage clearly caused retries we can propose waiving retried portion + SLA credit (per contract SLA credit = 10% of monthly committed invoice = $1,800).
maria (Finance Manager): Proposed remediation: waive retried token charges ($672) and apply SLA credit $1,800. Net customer credit = $2,472. That keeps most of committed revenue while acknowledging service disruption. Approve accounting treatment?
ajay (AcctOps): From ops side we'd post a negative line item on INV-11022 for $2,472 and create journal entry JE-2026-11-HELM. Need finance manager approval to proceed.
dmitri (Sales): :thumbsup: I approve the customer-facing number. I'll confirm with HelmCare and offer to expedite the corrected invoice. Sasha, please notify the PM.
sasha (Customer Success): I'll message them now and offer the consolidated credit + updated invoice within 24h. Will share response here.
maria (Finance Manager): Approved. Ajay, proceed with the credit entry and updated invoice. Add note: "SLA credit + retry waiver for region outage 2026-11-05".
ajay (AcctOps): Done — updated invoice link: https://billing.redwood/INVOICES/INV-11022?view=adjusted. JE posted: JE-2026-11-HELM. Please confirm once you see the revised PDF.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-11022 adjusted: credit $2,472 applied by ajay (AcctOps). PDF: https://billing.redwood/INVOICES/INV-11022/pdf
sasha (Customer Success): HelmCare replied: "Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. That works for us." Closing with :white_check_mark:.
lena (Finance): Thanks team. Quick follow-up: ask platform to add retry-attribution tag to future metering so we can auto-detect these cases in the true-up flow. Filing a ticket with eng-platform now.
dmitri (Sales): Heads up — I'll mark this customer as "sensitive" for next 90 days in CRM.
maria (Finance Manager): Logging note for audit: decision rationale recorded in GL comment for JE-2026-11-HELM.
ajay (AcctOps): All set. Closing thread.
